reviews.title: Nvidea cards Rock
reviews.comment: Fantastic card, i upgraded from radeon RX 6750 XT 12gb, night and day, RT 3.5 gen before no RT. not a hugh jump on FPS, but 3440x1440p i get 100+ in most AAA games, games that are a few years old 2019-2022 150+ fps

reviews.title: Got one at a Best Buy
reviews.comment: All I can say is it's a very solid card. Luckily I didn't pay way way too much now seeing it's the same price as the 4080 super now. Glad I got one. If you have not picked up a high performance GPU by now, you are messed over. But get ready it's going to be even worse with the 5000 series. You will get ultra messed over. Glad I bought at the end of a generation when the time was right, cause in 2025? Very very few gamers will be able to even get the 5000 series at non scalper prices.
